root_idea.summary: The root is oriented toward gathering, aggregation, and the formation of a compact or congregated mass.
root_idea.development: The lexical development extends from collecting and compacting things to pressing together, forming balls or masses, and the reduplicated action of tumbling or being cast together into a hollow.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form كَبْكَبَ rather than the inflected QAC lemma.

senses.definition: To overturn or cast down so that what is thrown turns over upon itself or upon others and comes to rest in a deep place.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic passive construction فَكُبْكِبُوا فِيهَا, the objects are interpreted as being gathered or thrown down into Hell, one upon another, tumbling until they settle there.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To invert or turn an object upside down; to turn a vessel or bowl over so as to pour out its contents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive Form I usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To throw someone down upon his face; to prostrate him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use describing forcible prostration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut or wound a camel in the legs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive use with a camel as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To convolve or glomerate thread or hair into balls.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical use referring to forming material into a كُبَّة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be weighty or heavy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form I usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To kindle or set fire to a plant or tree called كُبّ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical use with كُبّ, a type of ḥamḍ plant, as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make كباب, meat cut into pieces and roasted or broiled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical Form II culinary use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bend the head or oneself down toward the ground or an object; to stoop.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may use عَلَى or إِلَى with the object or direction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fall prostrate or prone, especially upon the face; also to fall after stumbling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-passive or intransitive use related to كَبَّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set about an undertaking and persist in it; to apply oneself or adhere to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَى and an undertaking, task, or work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For camels to be prostrated by disease or emaciation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject is the herd or its members in a Form V use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become contracted and compact through moisture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of sand or a similar material that becomes moist and compact.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wrap oneself in a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical use describing a person bundled or wrapped in clothing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To press or crowd together upon something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction with عَلَيْهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become inverted or turned down, as a jug or similar vessel, so as to pour out its contents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form VII use describing the vessel's resulting position.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect scattered property by bringing its dispersed extremities together, including by driving dispersed camels together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive reduplicated use with scattered wealth, property, or animals as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect themselves together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reduplicated Form V use describing people or other subjects becoming gathered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant or tree of the ḥamḍ kind, used especially for kindling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective botanical noun, also treated as a noun of unity with ـة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A forceful charge, assault, or single impetus; also the collision of troops, the release of horses to charge, and a violent onset.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same noun is extended to the vehemence of winter and a dash or rush of fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A throwing into a deep place or hollow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun associated with the act of casting something into a depth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A collected mass of dust, earth, or other material; also a ball or compact mass of spun thread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The material may be accumulated naturally or convolved into a ball; the term is also used of hair formed in this way.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A congregated company, troop, or main body, especially of horses or men; also a herd of great camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense includes the greater number or main part of a troop and similar collective uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A family or household dependent upon someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression عَلَيْهِ كُبَّةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pressing or crowding together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal expression for congregating with pressure or compression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weight or the burden of one's mass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively in expressions such as throwing one's weight upon someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Meat cut into small pieces and roasted or broiled, often over burning coals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A culinary noun, noted as possibly borrowed or non-Arabic by some authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A very large number of camels, sheep, or goats, so numerous that they seem to mount upon one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used adjectivally of an abundant herd.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dust, earth, adhesive clay, moist earth, or sand compacted by moisture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense includes an abundance of soft earth that cleaves or coheres together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A medicinal substance from China, identified with cubeb or Piper cubeba.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized materia-medica term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain game of the Arabs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized cultural noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man of compact and strong make.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is given as كَبَاكِبُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An excellent kind of thick dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A closely congregated body of men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective noun for a compact human group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fat woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical noun specifically defined with a female referent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who constantly stumbles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived adjective describing habitual stumbling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who looks much toward the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-nominal description of a person's habitual posture or gaze.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dust-coloured wheat with thick ears and stout straw.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural adjective or noun.

cautions: The single Quran occurrence is a passive plural form; the lexical headword is normalized to the Form I perfect كَبْكَبَ.
The reported interpretations of فَكُبْكِبُوا فِيهَا emphasize related aspects of the construction: being collected, thrown down, turned over repeatedly, and settling one upon another in a deep place.
